label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Baycurrent Classic tight at top
items.text: Keith Mitchell shot 6-under 65 to share the Baycurrent Classic lead at 11-under 131 with Jacob Bridgeman; Max Homa, Zach Bauchou, and Ben Kohles are two shots back at 9-under.

items.headline: Bradley’s rant ousts Ryder Cup official
items.text: A rules official vowed never to return to the Ryder Cup after a furious rant from Keegan Bradley, marking a notable disruption for Team USA.

items.headline: Chacarra mulls withdrawal at Spanish Open
items.text: Eugenio Chacarra leads the Spanish Open after a 66 but is considering withdrawing due to a painful fractured toe, which could impact his Ryder Cup momentum.
